description:
Partner with Wigglitz! (Let Your Wigglitz Out)
About our brand and products:
Wigglitz by ZB Designs doesn’t just make toys—we build worlds and bring them to life. We create a living system of play featuring articulated, highly collectible figures built to move exactly the way imagination moves: freely, wildly, and without limits. They wiggle, transform, and evolve. We are on a mission to spark a joyful family rebellion against screen addiction, turning passive device consumption into messy, alive, real-world human connection.
What makes us different:
We are a verb-first brand obsessed with what’s next and what’s never been seen before. Instead of competing with iPads, iPhones, and laptops, we hijack them. Our community turns slick tablet screens into skating rinks, angled iPhones into diving boards, and open laptops into tents and obstacle courses for their figures. We build memories, rituals, and lifelong bonds through physical, unexpected play.
How affiliates can earn:
We are looking for creative partners, parents, collectors, and builders to join our workshop crew. You will earn competitive cash commissions on every tracked sale you refer, backed by an optimized cookie window to ensure you get paid for your organic reach. Top-performing partners also gain access to exclusive performance bonuses and rare character tiers.
How to promote us:
We want you to join our quiet rebellion! Show your audience what happens when you turn off algorithm hell and "Let Your Wigglitz Out." Create short-form videos, Reels, and TikToks using our "Alternative Uses" prompts: film your Wigglitz ice-skating across an iPad, tightrope-walking a phone balance beam, or racing through a keyboard track. Share your custom affiliate links and exclusive coupon codes alongside authentic, chaotic, screen-free family fun.
Other information:
Approved creators gain immediate access to our fully loaded asset drive, featuring high-impact brand stills, launch film clips, pre-cleared audio SFX, and product GIFs. Vetted affiliates are eligible for free product seeding and sample kits to fuel their content. Drop the screens, grab some figures, and let's build something unforgettable together!

Welcome to Wigglitz! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Intellectual Property, Content Usage, and Advertising Rights
By participating in this Program, requesting or accepting free product samples, or earning commissions, the Affiliate grants Wigglitz a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully sub-licensable, and transferable right and license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, translate, create derivative works from, distribute, and display any content created in relation to the Program. This includes, but is not limited to, photos, videos, reviews, TikToks, Instagram Reels, YouTube videos, and blog posts (collectively, "Affiliate Content").
Wigglitz reserves the absolute right to use Affiliate Content for any marketing, advertising, or promotional purposes across all digital and physical platforms. This includes running paid social media advertisements (such as Meta ads, TikTok ads, Google Ads, "whitelisting," or "dark posts") across any platform we choose, at any time. The Affiliate explicitly agrees that they are not entitled to any additional financial compensation, residuals, usage fees, or royalties for our use of this content beyond the standard affiliate commissions outlined in Section 3.

8. Removal from Referral Program
If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so at any time by contacting: matthew@wigglitz.com. Upon removal, your tracking links will be deactivated, and any remaining approved balances will be paid out during the next standard payment cycle.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to matthew@wigglitz.com for support.
